about_the_game:
🧟 Zomboard – A Hardcore Zombie Survival Strategy Game

Zomboard is a top-down, tile-based survival builder where you must manage survivors, construct and defend your base against thousand zombies. Every decision matters as the undead attack with overwhelming number.

🔥 Core Features:
✅ Massive Zombie Hordes – Undead spawn endlessly, scaling in strength and numbers.
✅ Survivor Management – Assign work, train skills, and keep survivors fed, rested, and armed.
✅ Base Building & Traps – Construct walls, turrets, and defenses to hold off the swarm.
✅ Crafting & Research – Unlock powerful weapons, armor, and tools to stay alive.
✅ Magic Abilities – Use special survivor abilities for defense and battlefield control.
✅ Intelligent Zombie Attacks – The undead wait, strategize, and rush in coordinated waves.
✅ No Escape – Only Survival – Play until your colony is overrun… or become legend.

Can you hold out when the horde comes? Or will your base fall to the undead?

short_description: Zomboard is a post-apocalyptic colony sim and base defense game. You begin with a few survivors, helping them build a base and fortify their defenses to survive against overwhelming zombie hordes.
